# "Needs live check" comments become `must` test cases for the live tester

## What to build

A human review comment can be marked **needs live check** (`liveCheck: true` on the `Comment` in `src/review/human.ts`). Spec: `docs/prd/06-human-review-round.md` §6, §7.4. After the user requests changes, every **open** comment (status `open` or `reopened`) with `liveCheck: true` is added to the live tester's test plan as an extra **`must`** case, in every review round, until the comment is resolved. Nothing new is needed downstream: the existing KAN-5 test-plan machinery already puts plan cases in the tester's prompt, requires a verdict for each one (`checkPlanCases`), and maps a failed `must` case to a blocker `plan-<id>` (`applyTestPlan`), which keeps the fix loop going.

If the run has no `test-plan.json`, the live-check cases form a plan on their own. Comments without `liveCheck` never reach the tester.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- Already built:
  - `src/review/human.ts` — `Comment` (`id` like `H1-2`, `round`, `file?`, `line?`, `snippet?`, `body`, `liveCheck`, `status`, `followUps`), `allComments(runDir, upToRound)`, `openComments(comments)` (status ≠ `resolved`).
  - `src/state/state.ts` — review state has `humanRound` (0 when no human review has happened yet).
- `src/graph/testPlan.ts` — `testCaseSchema` (8-14): `id` matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/` (so `H1-2` is valid), `title` min 1, `steps` min 1 item, `expected` min 1, `priority: "must" | "should"`; `testPlanSchema = { cases: min(1) }` (15); `TestPlan` type; `loadTestPlan` (21-55).
- `src/review/context.ts` — `ReviewerContext` (21-38) has `testPlan?`; `buildReviewerContext(opts)` (54-76) calls `loadTestPlan(tasksDir)` (line ~58).
- `src/review/phase.ts` — `reviewRound` (237-344): builds the context via `buildReviewerContext` (243-250), line 288 `const report = kind === "tester" && context.testPlan ? applyTestPlan(raw, context.testPlan, previous(kind)) : raw;`, and the give-up path (293-322) also uses `context.testPlan`.
- `src/agents/tester.ts` — plan section in `testerPrompt` (69-81) and plan instructions (99-105); `runLiveTester` (172-180) passes `plan: opts.context.testPlan`.
- `src/review/report.ts` — `checkPlanCases` (138-155), `applyTestPlan` (187-234), `planFindingId` (180-181).
- Tests: `src/agents/tester.test.ts` (98-110: `testerPrompt({ ...ctx, testPlan: plan }, 0, "/r/tester.json")`, `expect(prompt).toContain("### P1 (must): Login works")`); `src/review/phase.test.ts` `runReview` (53-95); fake provider `tester:tester-r<N>` attempts with `report: { cases: [...] }`.

## Patterns to follow

**Comment → case** (add to `src/review/human.ts`):
```ts
/** Open comments marked "needs live check", as must cases for the live tester (id = comment id). */
export function liveCheckCases(comments: readonly Comment[]): TestCase[] {
  return openComments(comments).filter((c) => c.liveCheck).map((c) => ({
    id: c.id,
    title: firstLine(c.body, 80),
    steps: [
      "Start the app as TESTING.md describes",
      c.file ? `Exercise the behavior of ${c.file}${c.line ? ` around line ${c.line}` : ""}` : "Exercise the changed behavior",
      `Check what the reviewer asked for: ${[c.body, ...c.followUps].join(" / ")}`,
    ],
    expected: [c.body, ...c.followUps].join(" / "),
    priority: "must",
  }));
}
/** The run's plan plus the live-check cases; undefined when both are empty. */
export function withLiveChecks(plan: TestPlan | undefined, extra: TestCase[]): TestPlan | undefined
```
`withLiveChecks` appends `extra` after the plan's cases; if a plan case id collides with a comment id, keep the plan's case and skip the comment's.

**Where:** extend `buildReviewerContext` options with `extraCases?: TestCase[]` and set `testPlan: withLiveChecks(await loadTestPlan(tasksDir), opts.extraCases ?? [])`. In `reviewRound`, when `progress.humanRound > 0` pass `extraCases: liveCheckCases(await allComments(opts.runDir, progress.humanRound))`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/human.ts` (+ tests)
- **IMPLEMENT**: `liveCheckCases`, `withLiveChecks`, a small `firstLine(text, max)`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/human.test.ts` — resolved and non-live comments are excluded; follow-ups appear in `expected`; result passes `testCaseSchema`; no plan + no cases → `undefined`; id collision keeps the plan case.

### UPDATE `src/review/context.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `extraCases` option.
- **GOTCHA**: no extra cases → `testPlan` is exactly what `loadTestPlan` returned (including `undefined`), so prompts are unchanged.

### UPDATE `src/review/phase.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: pass `extraCases` from `reviewRound` when `progress.humanRound > 0`.

### ADD tests (`src/review/phase.test.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: human review on; during the pause add a comment with `liveCheck: true` and request changes; script the tester for the next round with `cases: [{ id: "H1-1", verdict: "fail", evidence: "GET /users returns 500 rows" }]` and the round after with `pass`. Assert:
  - the tester prompt after the request contains `### H1-1 (must):`;
  - the failed case creates a blocker `plan-H1-1` and causes another fix pass;
  - once it passes, the run pauses again;
  - a comment without `liveCheck` never appears in the tester prompt;
  - a run with its own `test-plan.json` (P1) gets both P1 and H1-1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Open `liveCheck` comments appear in the tester prompt as `must` cases, every round, until resolved
- [ ] A failed live-check case is a blocker `plan-<comment id>` and keeps the fix loop going
- [ ] Works with and without a `test-plan.json`
- [ ] Comments without `liveCheck` never reach the tester
- [ ] Without human review, prompts are unchanged; `npm test` passes

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npx vitest run src/review src/agents/tester.test.ts
```
